source.name: MASSIVE 1.1
source.citation: FitzGerald et al., "MASSIVE: A 1M-Example Multilingual Natural Language Understanding Dataset with 51 Typologically-Diverse Languages", 2022
source.sampling: 600 of 2974 test utterances, proportional to scenario, seed 42; identical ids across locales

method.ece: 10 equal-width bins; CI = percentile bootstrap, 1000 resamples, seed 42
method.heldout: items split in two halves by a hash of their id (seed 42); the threshold is chosen on the tuning half and every held-out number is computed on the other half

heldout.rule: cheapest threshold matching System 2 accuracy on the tuning half

heldout_best.rule: most accurate threshold on the tuning half (cheapest among ties)
